convenciones.watts: positive = generates power, negative = consumes power
convenciones.capacidad_wh: batteries only (energy storage in watt-hours); 0 for everything else
convenciones.slots: fairing slots: how much space the part takes inside the rocket's payload fairing
convenciones.calor: heat the part gives off, scale 0-10 (low=2, medium=4, high=7, extreme=10; 0 = none)
convenciones.requiere: ALL ids in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.requiere_alguno_de: at least ONE id in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.incompatible: the listed ids cannot be combined with this part
convenciones.sinergia: ids of parts or mission-objective tags (e.g. mapeo_orbital) that give a bonus
convenciones.vulnerable_a: ids of events that damage the part (see eventos_sugeridos)
convenciones.penalizaciones: list of rules. {si_falta: id} or {si_falta_ninguno_de: [ids]}; if the condition is not met, 'efecto' applies
convenciones.ids: lowercase, no accents, underscores. Must match the key. Must be identical across all team files
convenciones.tags: capabilities of the part. A mission can require a tag (any part with it will do) or a specific id
convenciones.alcance_ua_max: optional (antennas): maximum communication distance in astronomical units (AU)
convenciones.solo_mision: optional: 'humana' (crewed) or 'robotica' (robotic). The part only applies to that mission type
convenciones.requiere_aterrizaje: optional: true = only works if the mission includes a landing (aterrizaje=true in missions.json)
convenciones.mitiga: optional: ids of events whose damage the part reduces or cancels
convenciones.ciencia_base: optional (instruments): science points per use turn. Game value
convenciones.aporta_capacidad_masa: engines and boosters only: adds to lift capacity (game units)
convenciones.masa_cuenta_como_carga: if false, its mass does not count as load to lift (default true)
convenciones.isp_vacio_real_s: real specific impulse in vacuum (s); informational only
convenciones.resumen: short one-line text shown in the hover tooltip

meta.regla_distancia_solar: real_power = watts * (1 / distance_in_AU^2). Mars (~1.5 AU) gets about 43% of Earth's sunlight, Jupiter (~5.2 AU) about 4%. Only applies to parts with depende_del_sol = true.
supuestos: Fairing capacities raised to 5 and 10 slots (original table: 3 and 6) after testing minimal robotic and crewed ships.
Engine and tank are tied together: Merlin burns RP-1 and RS-25 burns LH2. Raptor (methane) was not included.
Mass of engines and tanks = 0 with masa_cuenta_como_carga=false: only the fairing and the dampers count as load.
Lift capacity is in game units (1 unit = 5 kg); it does not represent the capacity of a real rocket.
Proposed additions: amortiguador_vibracion, -2 capacity for the expanded fairing, fairing-MLI synergy.
meta.reglas_lanzamiento: To launch: 1 fairing + 1 engine + the tank that engine requires + 1 flight computer. Boosters and dampers are optional. Launch is blocked if payload mass > lift capacity, or if slots used > the fairing's capacidad_slots.

cofia_estandar.descripcion: The aerodynamic shell on top of the rocket that shields the spacecraft during ascent. Anything that does not fold up or fit inside cannot be launched.
cofia_estandar.efecto_juego: Holds ships up to 5 volume slots. Its mass (+2) adds to the load the rocket must lift.
cofia_estandar.notas: Capacity 5 (it was 3 in the original table): a minimal ship already used 4 slots.

cofia_expandida.descripcion: A wider fairing for ships with deployable solar panels, large antennas or bulky instruments. It causes more air drag during ascent.
cofia_expandida.efecto_juego: Holds ships up to 10 slots. More atmospheric drag: it subtracts 2 from lift capacity and heats the payload.
cofia_expandida.notas: Capacity 10 (it was 6): a minimal crewed ship with shielding did not fit in 8. The -2 penalty and the link to MLI are proposals. Required by panel_desplegable and espectrometro_masas.

tanque_rp1_lox.descripcion: There is no oxygen in space, so a rocket carries both fuel and oxidizer. RP-1 is refined kerosene; liquid oxygen is stored at -183 C.
tanque_rp1_lox.efecto_juego: Standard fuel: heavy but stable. Used by the medium-thrust engine.
tanque_rp1_lox.notas: Real data: specific impulse (Isp) of about 311 s in vacuum with liquid oxygen and RP-1 (Falcon 9). Isp measures fuel efficiency: higher is better. Secondary source: spaceodysseyhub.com.

tanque_lh2_lox.descripcion: Liquid hydrogen at -253 C: the most efficient chemical rocket fuel, but extremely light, so the tanks must be enormous and delicate.
tanque_lh2_lox.resumen: Liquid hydrogen: pricey and very efficient.
tanque_lh2_lox.efecto_juego: Very expensive but extremely efficient: lets the rocket lift more payload. Used by the heavy-lift engine.
tanque_lh2_lox.notas: Real data: Isp of about 452 s in vacuum (RS-25). For the same volume, liquid hydrogen weighs about one fourteenth as much as water and one eleventh as much as RP-1, so it needs huge tanks.

motor_empuje_medio.descripcion: A liquid-fuel engine: costly and complex, but it can be shut down, restarted and throttled.
motor_empuje_medio.precio_real_ref: No public engine price; a complete Falcon 9 launch lists at about 74 million USD (2026), and NASA has paid 69-100 million USD
motor_empuje_medio.efecto_juego: Lifts ships up to 15 mass units. If ship + fairing weigh more, launch is blocked. Essential for precise maneuvers.
motor_empuje_medio.notas: Merlin 1D: about 845 kN of thrust at sea level, Isp 311 s in vacuum and 282 s at sea level. It burns RP-1, which is why it requires tanque_rp1_lox.

motor_carga_pesada.descripcion: A cryogenic engine burning liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen, the most efficient liquid engine in use. It can be throttled between 67% and 109% of rated power.
motor_carga_pesada.precio_real_ref: RS-25: about 146 million USD per engine according to a secondary (unofficial) source
motor_carga_pesada.efecto_juego: Lifts ships up to 40 mass units. Needed for heavy crewed missions.
motor_carga_pesada.notas: RS-25: 1,859 kN of thrust at liftoff, Isp 452 s in vacuum and 366 s at sea level (NASA SLS). The Raptor engine burns methane, so it was not included: there is no methane tank.

booster_srb_par.descripcion: Solid-fuel rockets: cheap and very powerful, but once lit they cannot be shut down or throttled.
booster_srb_par.resumen: +10 lift, but it shakes and can't shut off.
booster_srb_par.efecto_juego: Adds +10 lift capacity but triggers the vibration meter. Without dampers, fragile parts (such as cameras) are damaged before reaching space.
booster_srb_par.notas: Typical solid-fuel Isp is 250-270 s (SLS boosters: 267 s). They do not allow precise maneuvers.

amortiguador_vibracion.descripcion: Mounts that isolate the spacecraft from the shaking of launch, especially with boosters.
amortiguador_vibracion.efecto_juego: Protects fragile instruments from launch vibration.
amortiguador_vibracion.notas: Part proposed during review: the original table mentioned dampers without defining them. Price and mass are game values.

computadora_comercial.descripcion: The rocket's standard onboard computer, with no special protection against radiation.
computadora_comercial.resumen: Budget computer: 90% reliable, weak to CMEs.
computadora_comercial.efecto_juego: Works 90% of the time. If a coronal mass ejection (CME) strikes during launch, the insertion orbit comes out wrong.

computadora_rad_hard.descripcion: A computer designed to survive the radiation and energetic particles of space weather.
computadora_rad_hard.resumen: Immune to space weather during launch.
computadora_rad_hard.efecto_juego: 100% immune to space-weather events during launch.
